protocol.claim_scope: synthetic local-shift and calibration-noise stress test

conditions.global_reversal: all context hazards map to 0.12^2 / source hazard
conditions.subject_scene_xor_reversal: contexts reverse iff subject_type=cup XOR scene=busy

protocol.inference: paired seed-cluster 20000-resample bootstrap and exact sign test
protocol.method_selection: all methods and both declared group axes reported; no axis or hyperparameter selected on target test
protocol.noise: deterministic event-status flips on target calibration only; clean target test; timing, features, and group IDs unchanged
protocol.split: outcome-independent group-id hash; maximum pool frozen; nested calibration subsets; one fixed group-disjoint test
protocol.subgroups: generator truth defines changed/stable test subsets for audit only; never available to fitted models
